propositions: Detached compaction sweep worker that dies between rename and commit leaves tracker working tree dirty (tracked deletions + untracked snapshot/retired files), blocking next reconverge and stranding local commits.
Current fold performs snapshot-write, retire-rename, and git-commit as separate non-atomic steps with no rollback mechanism, making the store vulnerable to crash/kill/race conditions.

Fix implements crash-atomic fold via intent journal written before mutation, ordered fold operations with whole-fold rollback on any failure, and startup recovery that discriminates landed vs. abandoned vs. superseded folds without losing events.

Recovery must distinguish transient git failures (index.lock, timeout) from permanent absent-object states to avoid mis-classifying a transient fault as snapshot-absent and incorrectly reverting a landed fold.
Incomplete rollback (failing reverse-rename) must retain uncommitted snapshot rather than delete it, preserving folded events for fsck to repair as SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT.
